preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: An error banner is displayed with the message 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'; the user remains on the login page

test_cases.test_case: Login with empty username and password fields
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: An error banner is displayed with the message 'Epic sadface: Username is required.'; the user remains on the login page

test_cases.test_case: Add a product to the cart
preconditions: User is on the Product Inventory page
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' for the first product listed
2. Observe the cart badge in the header
test_cases.expected_result: The cart badge count increases by 1; the 'Add to cart' button changes to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product to the cart when not logged in
preconditions: User is on the Product Inventory page
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' for the first product listed
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; no product is added to the cart

test_cases.test_case: Add maximum number of products to the cart
preconditions: User is on the Product Inventory page
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' for every product listed
2. Observe the cart badge in the header
test_cases.expected_result: The cart badge count equals the total number of products available; all 'Add to cart' buttons change to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Complete a full checkout with multiple items in the cart
preconditions: At least two products have been added to the cart
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
3. Enter 'John' in the First Name field
4. Enter 'Doe' in the Last Name field
5. Enter '12345' in the Zip/Postal Code field
7. Review the order summary on the Overview page
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page displays 'Thank you for your order!'; the cart badge is no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to checkout with missing required fields
preconditions: At least one product has been added to the cart
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
3. Leave the First Name field empty
4. Leave the Last Name field empty
5. Leave the Zip/Postal Code field empty
test_cases.expected_result: An error banner is displayed for each missing field; user remains on the Information page

test_cases.test_case: Checkout with maximum length input in fields
preconditions: At least one product has been added to the cart
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page
3. Enter a 255-character string in the First Name field
4. Enter a 255-character string in the Last Name field
5. Enter a valid 10-digit Zip/Postal Code in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Overview page with the order summary displayed

preconditions: User is on the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; protected pages are no longer accessible

preconditions: At least one product has been added to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The cart is cleared; all 'Add to cart' buttons revert to their original state
